attestations.text: FUNINGGAN 富寧安 d. 1728, general, was a member of the Fuca clan and belonged to the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner. His father, Alantai 阿蘭泰, (d. 1699), Grand Secretary for ten years (1689–1699), was unreservedly trusted by Emperor Shêng-tsu and was given the posthumous name Wên-ch'ing 文清.
